identity.statusNote: As of Local 6.0 (announced by WP Engine), all previously paid 'Local Pro' features are now included free for every user; the product no longer has a paid tier of its own.

sources.title: Local 6.0 - Pro for everyone (via search snippet)

freePlan.limits: All features, including the formerly paid 'Local Pro' add-ons (Live Links, Connect, Cloud Backups, Image Optimizer), are free for every user as of Local 6.0.

keyLimits.en: All features, including the formerly paid Pro add-ons, included at no cost.

cautions.en: Local previously sold a paid 'Local Pro' subscription; WP Engine made all Pro features free for everyone starting with Local 6.0, so older third-party pricing information referencing a paid Pro tier is stale.

capabilities.en: Local WordPress development environment for building, testing and iterating on WordPress sites offline.
Live Links: shareable temporary public URLs for a local site, for client or team review.
Connect and Cloud Backups: syncing and backing up local sites, with the Image Optimizer add-on for compressing site assets.
Add-ons ecosystem extending core functionality (e.g. integrations with Advanced Custom Fields, WP Migrate).

limitations.en: Focused on WordPress specifically; not a general-purpose local dev environment for other CMS or frameworks.
Owned and maintained by WP Engine, which also sells managed WordPress hosting, a potential conflict of interest for hosting-agnostic workflows.
